sections.heading: Over 30 years on the road, kindness first
sections.intro:
For more than 30 years Hai Van has put passengers' safety and kindness first — from the moment you walk into the lounge until you step off the bus. On the Ho Chi Minh City – Vung Tau route, over 120 limousine departures a day are ready for you, with flexible pickup and booking right on your phone.
Kindness from the heart – care in every action

sections.heading: Bus schedules & fares: Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City
A more considerate way back to Ho Chi Minh City
sections.intro:
Over 30 years carrying passengers, Hai Van prioritizes your comfort and safety. Every trip is driven by a seasoned driver who knows the route, in a vehicle kept to standard.
Hai Van is also one of the few operators allowed to pick up and drop off right at terminals T1, T2 and T3 of Tan Son Nhat Airport, so your airport–Vung Tau leg stays seamless, easy and unhurried.

items.title: Terminals open almost all day
items.text: Vung Tau departures run 2am–9:45pm and Ho Chi Minh City 5am–midnight. A bus every 15–30 minutes, so there is no single timetable to plan around.

items.title: Flexible pickup and drop-off
items.text: Board at an office, a stop on the route or near your accommodation within the service area; Ba Ria passengers board at 54 Le Thanh Duy. In Ho Chi Minh City, onward shuttles reach Cho Ray, Tu Du, Children's Hospital 2 and the Oncology Hospital. Share your address when booking.

items.title: Tan Son Nhat airport service
items.text: The Hai Van desk sits at the airport pickup column inside Tan Son Nhat: luggage help, ticketing and a place to wait. The bus collects you at the desk, not from an outdoor car park. If your flight is late, call to move to a later departure.

items.title: 3 vehicle classes, 100% limousine
items.text: More than 40 Royal, Luxury and Economy buses. Air conditioning, wifi, USB charging, water and cool towels on board; massage seats on the higher classes. Compare interiors below the timetable.

items.title: No overcrowding, no extra seats
items.text: Every passenger gets a numbered seat from the map. Hai Van sells no extra seats, allows no floor spaces and takes on no extra passengers along the way; buses keep to the registered route and slots. Fares include VAT.

items.title: E-tickets, flexible changes
items.text: Pick your own seat on the map and the e-ticket lands straight on your phone. To change or cancel, just call 1900 6763 at least an hour before departure.

sections.heading: Limousine buses from Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City
sections.intro: Compare Royal, Luxury and Eco interiors, seating layouts and amenities for your departure. Open a vehicle class to view its times and fares.

sections.heading: Hai Van lounges and airport ticket desks
sections.intro: Three lounges in Ho Chi Minh City and one in Vung Tau, open 7:00am – 9:00pm daily with staff on hand, air-conditioning, drinks and luggage storage. If you land at Tan Son Nhat, Hai Van has a desk at all three terminals — T1, T2 and T3. Buses keep running outside lounge hours as shown below.

faq_section.heading: Bus ticket FAQs: Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City
faq_section.intro: Still need help? Call 1900 6763 or chat Zalo.

faq.q: How much is a Hai Van bus ticket from Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City?
faq.a: Select your departure date from Vung Tau and a service to District 1, Ho Chi Minh City. Fares depend on the vehicle class and seat; they may differ from your outbound journey. Check the applicable amount before confirming.

faq.q: How long does the bus from Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City take?
faq.a: Allow roughly three hours to Ho Chi Minh City, depending on pickup location, transfers and traffic. Check the estimated arrival at District 1 and leave extra time before onward plans.

faq.q: Where do I board in Vung Tau for District 1?
faq.a: A Vung Tau service location is at 156B Le Hong Phong. Check the pickup address and time confirmed for your departure before travelling there.

faq.q: Can I be picked up near my Vung Tau hotel or resort?
faq.a: Pickup support is available within service areas. Provide your Vung Tau hotel or resort address to confirm the meeting point, pickup time and transfer conditions before leaving for Ho Chi Minh City.

faq.q: Should I choose Royal, Luxury or Economy from Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City?
faq.a: Compare the available seats, amenities and fare for your preferred return departure. Check the class and layout of that Vung Tau–District 1 service rather than assuming it matches the bus you took in the opposite direction.

faq.q: How do I find a different departure time from Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City?
faq.a: Select the date you want to leave Vung Tau, then compare departure times and available seats to District 1. If nothing suits your plans, try another date or contact Hai Van; one day’s timetable does not apply to every date.

faq.q: How do I book a one-way bus from Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City?
faq.a: Choose your travel date, departure and available seats for this direction; no return date is required. Review the pickup point, destination and fare before following the booking instructions. Selecting seats does not mean your ticket is confirmed.

faq.q: How can international visitors book and pay?
faq.a: Choose your departure and seats, enter your contact details and verify your phone number when requested. Hai Van’s guide includes international cards; use a payment option available during your booking. Contact support if the verification code does not arrive.

faq.q: How does the Vung Tau to Tan Son Nhat airport service work?
faq.a: Hai Van has a service desk at the airport pickup column at Tan Son Nhat, where staff help with luggage and the vehicle collects you at the desk rather than from an outside car park. The Vung Tau terminal opens at 2am for early flights; allow about 2 hours 55 minutes of travel plus check-in time.

faq.q: What time does the Vung Tau to Ho Chi Minh City bus run?
faq.a: The Vung Tau terminal opens at 2am and the last departure of the day leaves at 9:45pm, with a bus every 15–30 minutes.

faq.q: How do I travel from Vung Tau to hospitals in Ho Chi Minh City?
faq.a: Buses arrive at central District 1 points and Hai Van then shuttles passengers on to the hospital. With the earliest departure at 2am, patients can arrive before queue numbers open. Call 1900 6763 in advance to name the hospital and confirm shuttle conditions for your trip.

faq.q: Is there a shuttle from other districts?
faq.a: Yes. Hai Van runs shuttles across most districts, bringing passengers to the main pickup points on the route. Coverage varies by departure and does not apply to discounted fares, so call 1900 6763 to confirm your area before booking.

faq.q: Where do passengers in Ba Ria board the bus to Ho Chi Minh City?
faq.a: The Ba Ria pickup point is 54 Le Thanh Duy, Phuoc Trung Ward. Select it when booking and check the pickup time shown on your ticket.

faq.q: What should I check about the date and direction before choosing a trip?
faq.a: Check the route Vung Tau → Ho Chi Minh City, travel date and passenger count before choosing a trip. This page sells one-way tickets; the opposite direction and round trips have their own pages.

faq.q: How do I confirm my pickup and drop-off points?
faq.a: Check the pickup address and meeting time on your ticket. Confirm the hotel meeting point if you need a transfer in Vung Tau.

faq.q: Why can the vehicle and fare differ between trips?
faq.a: Product name, seat count, amenities and fare can differ by trip; confirm them before paying.

faq.q: Who can help with travelling with a child or changing my trip?
faq.a: Contact Hai Van on 1900 6763 to confirm seating for your child and the change conditions for your ticket. Provide your travel date, route and booking reference if you already have one.

reviews.quote: Chất lượng xe tốt, tài xế rất chuyên nghiệp, nhân viên hỗ trợ nhiệt tình và thân thiện. Đặc biệt phòng chờ nhà xe rất tuyệt. Mình đã đi rất nhiều nhà xe và đây là trải nghiệm khiến mình rất hài lòng và ưng ý. Hy vọng nhà xe tiếp tục duy trì chất lượng dịch vụ.

reviews.quote: Nhà chờ xe Hai Van tiện nghi sạch sẽ nhân viên lịch sử có nước uống cho khách đợi, nằm ngay trung tâm quận 1, rất thuận tiện cho việc đi lại mà ko di chuyển ra bến xe.
